sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM label_asset ba WHERE ba.entry_id = n.entry_id AND ba.deleted = 0 AND ba.batch_id IN #{bid})

mapper.sql: FROM label_entry_node n INNER JOIN label_task t ON t.id = n.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.operator_id
mapper.select:
SELECT n.operator_id AS memberId, SUM(CASE WHEN n.status = 'claimed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN n.status = 'skipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skippedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN n.status = 'abandoned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abandonedCount
WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status IN ('claimed', 'skipped', 'abandoned') AND n.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND n.update_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND n.update_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY n.operator_id

SELECT n.operator_id AS memberId, AS memberName, CASE WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) = 'cuboid' THEN 'box3d' WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) IN ('point_cloud_instance', 'segmentation') THEN 'seg3d' WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) IN ('keypoint', 'skeleton', 'point') THEN 'point' WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) IN ('polyline', 'line') THEN 'line' WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) IN ('polygon', 'brush', 'mask') THEN 'seg2d' ELSE 'box2d' END AS kind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM label_entry_node n INNER JOIN label_task t ON t.id = n.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_asset ast ON ast.entry_id = n.entry_id AND ast.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_annotation a ON a.asset_id = ast.id AND a.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_annotation_object ao ON ao.annotation_id = a.id AND ao.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.operator_id WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = 'done' AND n.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND n.done_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND n.done_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND (ast.frame_flag IS NULL OR ast.frame_flag = 'normal')
GROUP BY n.operator_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, kind ORDER BY memberId ASC, cnt DESC

SELECT n.operator_id AS memberId, AS memberName, CASE WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) = 'cuboid' THEN 'box3d' WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) IN ('point_cloud_instance', 'segmentation') THEN 'seg3d' WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) IN ('keypoint', 'skeleton', 'point') THEN 'point' WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) IN ('polyline', 'line') THEN 'line' WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.kind')), ao.object_type) IN ('polygon', 'brush', 'mask') THEN 'seg2d' ELSE 'box2d' END AS kind, COALESCE(ao.class_id, 0) AS classId, COALESCE(lc.label_name, CONCAT('未指定标签#', COALESCE(ao.class_id, 0))) AS className, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM label_entry_node n INNER JOIN label_task t ON t.id = n.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_asset ast ON ast.entry_id = n.entry_id AND ast.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_annotation a ON a.asset_id = ast.id AND a.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_annotation_object ao ON ao.annotation_id = a.id AND ao.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_class lc ON lc.id = ao.class_id AND lc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.operator_id WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = 'done' AND n.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND n.done_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND n.done_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AND (ast.frame_flag IS NULL OR ast.frame_flag = 'normal')
GROUP BY n.operator_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, kind, COALESCE(ao.class_id, 0), COALESCE(lc.label_name, CONCAT('未指定标签#', COALESCE(ao.class_id, 0))) ORDER BY memberId ASC, kind ASC, cnt DESC

SELECT n.operator_id AS memberId, AS memberName, DATE_FORMAT(n.done_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS value
WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = 'done' AND n.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND n.done_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND n.done_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY n.operator_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, DATE_FORMAT(n.done_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT s.memberId AS memberId, s.memberName AS memberName, s.day AS day,
COALESCE(SUM(s.tagCnt), 0) COUNT(DISTINCT s.unitKey) AS value FROM ( SELECT n.operator_id AS memberId, AS memberName, DATE_FORMAT(n.done_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COALESCE(a.frame_id, a.asset_id, ast.id) AS unitKey,
COUNT(CASE WHEN ast.frame_flag IS NULL OR ast.frame_flag = 'normal' THEN ao.id END) AS tagCnt FROM label_entry_node n INNER JOIN label_task t ON t.id = n.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_asset ast ON ast.entry_id = n.entry_id AND ast.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_annotation a ON a.asset_id = ast.id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_annotation_object ao ON ao.annotation_id = a.id AND ao.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.operator_id WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = 'done' AND n.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND n.done_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND n.done_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY n.operator_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, DATE_FORMAT(n.done_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), COALESCE(a.frame_id, a.asset_id, ast.id) ) s GROUP BY s.memberId, s.memberName, s.day ORDER BY s.day ASC

SELECT n.operator_id AS memberId, AS memberName, DATE_FORMAT(n.done_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COALESCE(SUM(LEAST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, n.claim_time, n.done_time), #{capSeconds})), 0) AS seconds, COUNT(*) AS doneCount
WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = 'done' AND n.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND n.claim_time IS NOT NULL AND n.done_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND n.done_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY n.operator_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, DATE_FORMAT(n.done_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT n.operator_id AS memberId, AS memberName, COUNT(*) AS submittedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status IN ('passed', 'rejected', 're_rejected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviewedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status IN ('rejected', 're_rejected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status = 'passed' AND COALESCE(e.reject_count, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS firstPassCount, COALESCE(SUM(e.reject_count), 0) AS reworkCount FROM label_entry_node n INNER JOIN label_task t ON t.id = n.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN label_data_entry e ON e.id = n.entry_id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.operator_id WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = 'done' AND n.node_type = 'label' AND n.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND n.done_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND n.done_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY n.operator_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name ORDER BY firstPassCount DESC LIMIT #{q.limit}
SELECT id AS id, team_name AS name FROM label_team WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY team_name ASC

SELECT p.id AS id, p.project_name AS name FROM label_project p WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND (p.team_id = #{q.teamId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM label_project_team pt WHERE pt.project_id = p.id AND pt.team_id = #{q.teamId} AND pt.deleted = 0))
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT n.operator_id AS id, AS name
WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND n.update_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND n.update_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 500

SELECT b.id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(b.batch_name, ''), b.batch_no, CONCAT('批次#', b.id)) AS name FROM label_asset_batch b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.project_id = #{q.projectId} ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT 500
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO label_work_session (user_id, project_id, task_id, node_key, work_date, active_seconds, last_heartbeat_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dto.projectId}, COALESCE(#{dto.taskId}, 0), COALESCE(#{dto.nodeKey}, 'label'), #{workDate}, #{seconds}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active_seconds = active_seconds + VALUES(active_seconds), project_id = COALESCE(VALUES(project_id), project_id), last_heartbeat_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW()
